status: 24/24 STARTER FRAMES QA PASS • ONLY QA-PASSED ASSETS EXPOSED
rule: Show only starter assets that passed QA. Final corrected rebuilds are used for RLS-014 and RLS-018. Starter must be a different asset from the public Master Still.

entries.title: It was already in the frame.
entries.prompt: Use the provided starter as the exact first frame. Fixed CAMERA 07 trail-camera shot in a wet tropical rainforest at night. The distant RLS presence is already partly hidden behind trunks and fog; only mist, leaves and tiny exposure changes move at first, then the obscured mass makes one minimal shift deeper behind the tree without revealing full anatomy. Audio: light rain, wet-leaf drip, distant insects, one faint branch creak. No zoom, no jump scare, no morphing, no face/fur/hands/full body, no text or timecode changes.

entries.title: This boulder was not here yesterday.
entries.prompt: Use the provided starter as the exact first frame. Wet tropical creek crossing at night with the massive upright boulder completely static and heavy. Motion only in flowing water, light rain, leaves, mist and tiny handheld settling. The boulder must not breathe, wobble, deform or read as a creature. Audio: creek, rain, insects, subtle stone scrape. No creature reveal, morphing, new objects or text changes.

entries.title: The forest went silent first.
entries.prompt: Use the existing QA-passed RLS-004 starter as the exact first frame. Begin with normal rain, insects and frogs; then the insect/frog layer drops away unnaturally fast while rain remains. Hold the silence, then allow one distant partially obscured RLS presence to make a tiny lateral shift behind foliage. Audio is the main hook. No full creature reveal, attack, camera whip, morphing or added text.

entries.title: Both sides of the bridge failed at the same height.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame. Rain-soaked rope bridge over a tropical ravine at night; both severed ends stay at the exact same height and do not break further. Only wet ropes, loose fibers, rain, mist and distant water move naturally. Audio: rain, ravine water, faint rope creaks and one low wooden groan. No attacker, creature, extra damage, text changes or dramatic zoom.

entries.title: The fog moved upstream.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame. At BLACKWATER CREEK, water and loose leaves flow downstream while the low fog moves steadily upstream in the opposite direction. Keep wind markers consistent so the contradiction is easy to read. Camera almost fixed. Audio: rushing creek, rain, leaves and insects. No creature, glowing fog, vortex, time-lapse or text changes.

entries.title: Camera 07 was found 28 feet above the trail.
entries.prompt: Use the final QA-passed recovery starter as the exact first frame. Preserve CAMERA 07, tree, laser, rangefinder and overlays. The rangefinder remains readable as 28.0 FT throughout. Ground-up recovery view with slight hand tremor, rain, wet bark, leaves and mist. Audio: light rain, canopy drip, soft clothing/breathing and one device beep. No monster, camera teleport, warped hands, morphing or text changes.

entries.title: Tonight’s footage matches a file from 1998.
entries.prompt: Use the QA-passed 1998 archive starter as the exact first frame. Preserve archive/date overlays. Keep aged field-camera character subtle and believable: low-light softness, slight sensor noise and exposure breathing, not VHS parody. A distant obscured RLS presence makes only one tiny movement behind foliage. Audio: rain, insects, faint recorder room tone, soft branch creak. No glitch transitions, modern UI, full reveal or fantasy glow.

entries.title: The 1998 map shows a river where the trail is now.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame. Preserve the 1998 map, river line, current trail and markings. Make only a slow natural hand adjustment aligning the mapped river with the present muddy trail. Rain beads on paper and glove; flashlight shifts subtly. Audio: rain on paper, clothing movement and distant unseen water. No map morphing, new symbols, magical overlays, creature reveal or text changes.

entries.title: FIELD RULE 01 — If the forest repeats your rhythm, leave.
entries.prompt: Use the QA-passed FIELD RULE 01 starter as the exact first frame and preserve notebook wording, lantern and gear. Visual motion stays minimal. Audio payoff: nearby gear makes a simple three-beat pattern; after a pause the forest returns the same three beats from far beyond camp with identical timing but a dull woody tone. No visible source, music, dialogue, creature reveal, moving notebook text or jump scare.

entries.title: You hear it before you see it.
entries.prompt: Use the existing QA-passed RLS-010 starter as the exact first frame. Audio leads: rain and insects, then one deep off-screen wood crack and nearby leaves react a beat later. Camera makes only a tiny instinctive adjustment. After a pause, a distant obscured RLS mass shifts behind trunks for under one second. No full body, face, fur, hands or clear anatomy. No attack, jump scare, morphing or added text.

entries.title: The highest gouge was nearly twelve feet up.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve gouges, measurement reference and tree geometry. Slowly trace the measurement upward with the flashlight, ending on the highest gouge near twelve feet. The marks remain static. Audio: rain, insects, soft boot movement and one faint high tree creak. No new gouges, creature reveal, measurement changes, warped trunk or dramatic zoom.

entries.title: The tree moved twice.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve the uprooted tree, root cavity, drag path and ground geometry. Do not animate the tree moving. Use a restrained handheld inspection of the drag groove and exposed roots while rain collects in the rut and mist/leaves move naturally. Audio: rain, trickling water, insects and a low distant trunk groan. No creature, moving tree, root morphing, new tracks or text changes.

entries.title: Camera 07 came back online from above us.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve the impossible high-angle CAMERA 07 viewpoint, trail layout and overlays. Camera is fixed high in the canopy; do not pan, tilt, zoom or float. Far below, team members make only tiny believable movements while near-lens leaves and rain mist move. Audio: canopy rain, wind through leaves and faint indistinct team voices. No creature reveal, duplicated people, text/timecode changes or morphing.

entries.title: The station was abandoned in 2014. The radio answered tonight.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve the abandoned station, radio, maps and labels. First the radio is dead; then one receive indicator activates, followed by brief static and one low partly unintelligible reply under two seconds. Camera only leans slightly toward the radio. Audio: roof rain, room drip, radio squelch, short distorted reply, silence. No creature, moving furniture, new text, supernatural glow or jump scare.

entries.title: It looked small until it stood up.
entries.prompt: Use the FINAL QA-passed RLS-014 UPPER TRAIL rebuild as the exact first frame. Preserve trail marker, scale references and tree positions. The distant irregular RLS forest mass stays heavily occluded and slowly rises just enough to reveal greater height. Never form a clear head, face, fur, hands, arms, legs or Bigfoot-like silhouette. Audio: rain, leaves, one deep wood strain and subdued breathing. No approach, attack, glowing eyes, morphing or dramatic zoom.

entries.title: Only one set going in. Nothing came back out.
entries.prompt: Use the FINAL QA-passed RLS-018 FIELD ARCHIVE rebuild as the exact first frame. Preserve notebook sentence, recovered photo, flashlight, layout and all visible text. Motion stays minimal: flashlight shifts, droplets slide, one gloved hand steadies the notebook. Track evidence remains ambiguous and unchanged. Audio: rain, paper/leather movement, quiet breathing and insects. No new writing, photo animation, changing track shapes, creature reveal or camera whip.

entries.title: Only one camera saw it.
entries.prompt: Use the QA-passed RLS-019 two-camera starter as the exact first frame. Preserve both feeds, same location/timestamp relationship and labels. One feed remains empty for the entire clip; only the second contains a distant obscured RLS presence making one tiny shift behind a trunk. Audio: low room tone, feed rain and electronic hum. No full reveal, screen morphing, timecode changes, extra figures or glitch transition.

entries.title: The bark was still warm.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve damaged bark, thermal device, scale and overlays. Exposed wood remains warmer than cold wet surroundings but does not keep heating. Only minor device adjustment, flashlight spill, rain and droplets move. Audio: rain, one device beep, wet glove/bark contact and insects. No creature, magical heat, hand deformation, changing wound shape or text drift.

entries.title: Every camera skipped the same 17 minutes.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve every camera tile, label and timestamp. All feeds stay on the same missing interval 02:03:00 → 02:20:00, exactly 17 minutes. Do not alter digits. Only rain outside, monitor glow, one subtle non-content-changing flicker and tiny camera breathing may move. Audio: roof rain, electronic hum and one quiet equipment click. No creature, new feed content, different time ranges, screen warping or glitch montage.

entries.title: CASE 001 — The Hollow Trail.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve root tunnel shape, trail and overlays. Make a very small cautious approach with realistic flashlight sweep, dripping roots, mist and rain. The hollow stays fixed and physically plausible; darkness inside reveals nothing. Audio: rain, root drips, mud steps and insects becoming slightly quieter near the entrance. No creature, glowing portal, root morphing, fantasy smoke or sudden zoom.

entries.title: The missing pack was found twenty feet above the ground.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve the pack, branch height, scale references and overlays. Low upward recovery view; the pack stays caught high in the canopy and may sway only slightly with the branch. Audio: canopy rain, leaves, faint strap creak and subdued breathing. No creature, falling pack, abnormal branch motion, extra gear, text changes or camera warp.

entries.title: The reflection had one more figure than the clearing.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve shoreline, trees, real clearing and reflection. Critical invariant: the real clearing remains empty of the extra figure; the water reflection contains exactly one additional distant dark figure throughout. Small ripples may distort it, but it never appears above water, vanishes, multiplies or glows. Audio: light rain, water drops, insects and one faint branch creak. No fantasy effects, duplicate moon, text changes or jump scare.

entries.title: FIELD RULE 02 — If a camera loses the trail, check above eye level.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve field setup, notebook/camera equipment, canopy geometry and overlays. Begin steady, then make one slow controlled upward tilt toward the canopy. Do not reveal a clear creature; only a high branch or camera strap makes one small movement above eye level while lower vegetation stays calm. Audio: rain, platform creak, leaves and one quiet strap/camera-housing creak. No new text, floating camera, humanoid silhouette, jump scare or morphing.

entries.title: Camera 07 wasn’t the only one recording.
entries.prompt: Use the starter as the exact first frame and preserve every camera's position, inward orientation, empty center and overlays. No camera physically rotates during the clip; they are already aimed inward. Viewer camera almost fixed while mist, rain and leaves move; two or three camera mechanism clicks/status lights may activate sequentially without changing orientation. The clearing center stays empty. Audio: light rain, insects, low forest tone and separated camera clicks. No giant silhouette, creature, center figure, extra devices, text changes or dramatic zoom.
